event.title: Counter-Strike: WBT Academy vs SAW Youngsters (BO1) - Circuito Retake Group A

markets.question: Counter-Strike: WBT Academy vs SAW Youngsters (BO1) - Circuito Retake Group A
markets.description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between WBT Academy and SAW Youngsters in the Circuito Retake Group A, initially scheduled for October 29, 2026 at 5:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "WBT Academy" if WBT Academy win the match against SAW Youngsters.

This market will resolve to "SAW Youngsters" if SAW Youngsters win the match against WBT Academy.
